purpose: The reader entry points every session starts from, and the documents whose kind their path does not say. Every other document's kind is derived by scripts/lib/document-kinds.mjs: records by root, the planning passes directory and dated names; the paths the kit's own commands write (proposal packets, entropy receipts, the idea ledger, the follow-up feed and register, the planning cost table and the release manifest template) by its kit kinds; generated pages by their marker line; the rest standing.
